title: Health, habits and daily routine
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a napirendedről, az egészséges életmódról, a táplálkozásról és a stresszkezelésről kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: How would you describe your daily routine during the school year?
followUps: Is there anything you would like to change about it?

questions.q: What does a healthy lifestyle mean to you?
How have your eating habits changed since you were a child?
Do you think school canteens in Hungary offer healthy food? Why or why not?
What do you do to stay fit, and how do you motivate yourself?
How do you deal with stress, for example before exams?
Why do you think so many teenagers don't get enough sleep?
What is your opinion of fitness and diet influencers on social media?
Should the state do more to encourage people to live healthily? How?
Which unhealthy habits are common among young people, and why?

usefulPhrases.en: I try to keep fit by ...
I tend to stay up late.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How would you describe your daily routine during the school year?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Pretty hectic, to be honest. I get up at half past six, catch the bus into Kecskemét and usually have seven lessons, so I'm rarely home before four. Then there's homework and handball training twice a week, which means I hardly ever go to bed before eleven.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Is there anything you would like to change about it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'd love to get more sleep. If school started at nine instead of eight, I'm sure I'd be far more focused in the first two lessons.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What does a healthy lifestyle mean to you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: For me, it's about balance rather than strict rules: eating regularly, moving every day and not letting stress take over. I don't think you have to give up chocolate completely – it's more about not overdoing it.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you think school canteens in Hungary offer healthy food? Why or why not?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In theory, yes. The rules on salt and sugar have become much stricter, but the food is often so bland that lots of students skip lunch and buy pastries from the bakery instead, which defeats the purpose.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Why do you think so many teenagers don't get enough sleep?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'd say it's mainly our phones. Most of us tend to stay up late scrolling, even when we're exhausted. And since school starts so early, we never catch up – it's a vicious circle.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó egyik kérdésre sem felel egy szóval – mindig indokol, és konkrét példát hoz a saját életéből (iskolabusz Kecskemétre, kézilabdaedzés, a menza helyett pékség), az általánosabb kérdésnél pedig okot és következményt is megnevez.

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos B2-es szerkezetek hibátlanul – második feltételes mondat (If school started at nine, I'm sure I'd be …), a 'tend to' + ige, a 'rather than' és a 'which means …' mondatra visszautaló vonatkozó mellékmondat.

Szókincs és stílus: a téma pontos szavai (hectic, bland, skip lunch, exhausted) mellett természetes, beszélt nyelvi fordulatok (to be honest, I'd say, in theory) – nem fogalmazást mond fel, hanem beszélget.
Érdemes megtanulni: „it's more about not overdoing it”, „which defeats the purpose”, „stay up late scrolling”, „it's a vicious circle”.
